facts.entity_name: Which is the most affordable and which is the most powerful motorcycle?
facts.value: The most affordable motorcycle in our lineup is the Storm 125 priced at ₹99,000 ex-showroom. The most powerful machines are our 648cc twin-cylinder models — the Thunderstrike 650, Thunderstrike 650 Rally, Voyager 650, Zenith 650 Scrambler, and Nightfall 650 — each producing 47 bhp (or 46 bhp for Nightfall 650).

facts.entity_name: Does Apex Moto have an electric motorcycle?
facts.value: Yes, the Spark E1 is our high-performance electric motorcycle. It features a 9 kW peak mid-drive PMSM motor, a 4.0 kWh battery pack, an IDC range of 140 km per charge, and fast-charging capability (0–80% in 50 minutes) priced at ₹1,49,000 ex-showroom.

facts.entity_name: What is the typical delivery timeframe after booking?
facts.value: In-stock motorcycles are delivered within 3 to 5 business days after full payment or loan disbursement. Special variants and limited editions (such as Thunderstrike 650 Rally, Phantom 350 Bobber, Zenith 650 Scrambler, and Nightfall 650) have an estimated delivery window of 2 to 3 weeks.
